package.name: mdrobot_mecanum
package.description: Mecanum drive layer for a 4-wheel base built from two dual-channel MDROBOT controllers (e.g. two PNT50) on one RS485 bus at distinct Modbus slave ids. Inverse/forward kinematics, a proportional wheel-speed clamp, an interactive wheel-identification wizard, and a keyboard teleop. Pure Python — no ROS 2 dependency, so it runs from a bare clone; the generic mdrobot library stays kinematics-free.
